sentences.text: Arijit Singh is an Indian Musician , singer , composer , music producer , recordist , and music programmer .	Indian	Indian people	Musician	Musician
He prominently sings in Hindi and Bengali .	Hindi	Hindi language	Bengali	Bengali language

He also has songs in Gujarati , Tamil , Telugu , Marathi , Assamese and Kannada .	Gujarati	Gujarati language	Tamil	Tamil language	Telugu	Telugu language	Marathi	Marathi language	Assamese	Assamese language	Kannada	Kannada
He excels in the skill of singing .	singing	singing
He has often been portrayed by the Indian media as a `` small town boy who made it big '' .	Indian	Indian people

Arijit is regarded as one of the most versatile and successful singers in the history of Indian Music and Indian Cinema .	Indian	Indian people	Indian Music	Music of India	Indian Cinema	Cinema of India
His singing is known for being melliflous , soulful and melodious .	singing	singing
His voice is been described as a voice that penetrates the soul and creates a sense of blissful relaxation , a voice that promises to spread happiness and touches the crux of the entire being .
He is applauded and praised for his art of giving `` emotions and soul to lyrics '' through his vocals .	lyrics	lyrics	vocals	vocals
Arijit 's voice and singing is been loved by the Indian music lovers , and it is said that it mesmerizes and soothes the soul of listeners .	Indian	Indian people	singing	singing
He is known for being shy and often stays away from limelight despite the fame and popularity that he enjoys in South Asia and amongst South Asian diaspora worldwide .	South Asia	South Asia

His first achievement came just during the beginning of his singing career when he received upcoming male vocalist of the year award at 2013 Mirchi Music Awards for his rendition of the song `` Duaa '' and was also nominated for the song `` Phir Le Aya Dil '' .	singing	singing	vocalist	vocalist	Mirchi Music Awards	Mirchi Music Awards	Duaa	Duaa	Phir Le Aya Dil	Phir Le Aya Dil

Music director and composer Pritam along with the Indian film production house Vishesh Films is been credited as the one who showed faith in his talent , and gave him initial songs of his career and thus became an important factor behind the `` emergence '' of Arijit Singh .	Indian	Indian people	Pritam	Pritam	Vishesh Films	Vishesh Films

Singh became very popular and shot to widespread prominence with the release of `` Tum Hi Ho '' in 2013 , composed and written by his Friend and Music Composer Mithoon from the film Aashiqui 2 .	Tum Hi Ho	Tum Hi Ho	Mithoon	Mithoon	Aashiqui 2	Aashiqui 2
He won the prestigious Filmfare Award for Best Male Playback Singer for the song in 2014 .	Singer	Vocalist	Filmfare Award for Best Male Playback Singer	Filmfare Award for Best Male Playback Singer
Arijit had won IBN Live Movie Award for the song `` Muskurane ki wajah '' in the Best Playback Singer category .	Singer	Vocalist	Muskurane ki wajah	Muskurane

He won Filmfare Award for Best Male Playback Singer for the song `` Sooraj Dooba Hain '' in 2016 .	Singer	Vocalist	Filmfare Award for Best Male Playback Singer	Filmfare Award for Best Male Playback Singer	Sooraj Dooba Hain	Sooraj Dooba Hain

In 2017 , at the 62nd Filmfare Awards , he won Best Male Playback Singer Award for the title track of the film Ae Dil Hai Mushkil .	Singer	Vocalist	62nd Filmfare Awards	62nd Filmfare Awards	Ae Dil Hai Mushkil	Ae Dil Hai Mushkil#Soundtrack

Arijit won Male Vocalist of The Year award at 2017 Mirchi Music Awards for his rendition of `` Ae Dil Hai Mushkil '' .	Mirchi Music Awards	Mirchi Music Awards	Ae Dil Hai Mushkil	Ae Dil Hai Mushkil#Soundtrack
He was honoured with Best Male Playback Singer award for the title track of the same film at Zee Cine Awards 2017 .	Singer	Vocalist	Zee Cine Awards	Zee Cine Awards
In a short span of time he has won almost every prestigious Indian music awards .	Indian	Indian people
He was awarded `` NISU Youth Icon '' award in 2014 , by National Indian Students and Alumni Union UK .	Indian	Indian people
